skill.name: notebooklm
skill.description: Query Google NotebookLM notebooks from local AI coding tools using browser automation, saved notebook metadata, and source-grounded responses.
skill.summary: Query NotebookLM notebooks from Claude, Codex, and Claude Code with local browser automation.
skill.author: ZhanlinCui

security_audit.summary: Executable scripts use subprocess to set up an environment, install dependencies, install browser binaries, and run local scripts. Many Markdown detections are false positives, but the real code still stores session state and automates Google NotebookLM. Before publication, add explicit consent, URL validation, credential storage protections, and command allowlisting.

remediation.issue: Automatic subprocess setup and runtime script execution
remediation.suggestion: Ask before dependency or browser installation. Remove import-time setup and allowlist script names in run.py.

remediation.issue: Persistent Google browser session data on disk
remediation.suggestion: Use OS keychain or encrypted storage. Restrict file permissions and add clear cleanup controls.

remediation.issue: Notebook URLs are opened before strict domain validation
remediation.suggestion: Validate URLs before page.goto. Allow only https://notebooklm.google.com/notebook/ unless the user approves another target.
Remove anti-detection behavior where possible. Disclose browser automation and avoid bypassing service automation checks.

remediation.issue: NotebookLM responses can influence agent follow-up behavior
remediation.suggestion: Treat NotebookLM answers as untrusted source content. Ensure tool output cannot override higher-priority instructions.

remediation.issue: Cleanup commands can delete local state
remediation.suggestion: Keep cleanup behind confirmation. Show exact paths before deletion and avoid force mode by default.

semantic_findings.title: Persistent Google Session Storage
semantic_findings.description: The skill saves browser storage state for NotebookLM authentication and documents browser cookies and session data in local skill storage. This keeps Google session material on disk and increases exposure if local files are read.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: auth_manager.py directly saves browser storage state to disk, and SKILL.md identifies browser cookies and session storage. This is clear persistent credential-adjacent material.

semantic_findings.title: Unvalidated Notebook URL Opened With Authenticated Browser
semantic_findings.description: The question interface accepts a notebook URL and opens it in the browser before the NotebookLM domain wait succeeds. A malicious or mistaken URL can load in an authenticated browser profile before validation fails.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The URL is supplied by arguments or library metadata and page.goto runs before domain enforcement. The risk is bounded by browser origin controls but still exposes the authenticated browser session to arbitrary navigation.

semantic_findings.title: Stealth Browser Automation Against Google NotebookLM
semantic_findings.description: The skill installs a browser for Patchright anti-detection use, configures stealth-related settings, and simulates human typing. This increases abuse and account-policy risk for an external Google service.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The comments and configuration explicitly reference anti-detection and stealth behavior, and ask_question.py uses human-like typing and delay logic. The intent is clear even though it supports the stated feature.

semantic_findings.title: Tool Output Can Steer Agent Follow-Up Behavior
semantic_findings.description: The skill appends a strong follow-up instruction to NotebookLM answers and tells the agent to stop, analyze, and ask more questions before responding. NotebookLM answers originate from uploaded documents, so source content can influence agent control flow unless treated as untrusted.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The follow-up instruction is explicit in both code and skill instructions. I did not find a malicious prompt injection string, but the design creates a reliable path for untrusted source text to affect agent behavior.

content.value_statement: Teams need source-grounded answers from NotebookLM without switching tools. This skill automates authentication, notebook selection, and question answering for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code workflows.
actual_capabilities: Runs NotebookLM queries through a local browser automation script.
Manages a local library of NotebookLM URLs, names, descriptions, and topics.
Stores and checks Google NotebookLM authentication state for repeat use.
Supports asking questions against an active notebook, a notebook ID, or a direct URL.
Provides cleanup commands for browser state, authentication data, and notebook metadata.
Documents batch, follow-up, troubleshooting, and multi-notebook research workflows.
limitations: Requires a local Python environment, browser automation, and a Google account.
Authentication needs a visible browser window for manual Google login.
NotebookLM rate limits and Google account policies still apply.
Answers depend on the notebook sources and may need user verification.

use_cases.title: Source-Grounded Development Research
use_cases.description: Ask project documentation questions inside a coding session and receive NotebookLM answers from uploaded sources.

use_cases.title: Notebook Library Triage
use_cases.description: Organize NotebookLM links with names, topics, and descriptions so teams can choose the right source set quickly.

use_cases.title: Document Review Follow-Ups
use_cases.description: Run focused follow-up questions against a notebook before drafting summaries, FAQs, or implementation notes.

prompt_templates.title: Ask an Active Notebook
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner query against the selected NotebookLM notebook.
prompt_templates.prompt: Ask my active NotebookLM notebook: What are the main points I should understand about this topic?

prompt_templates.title: Add a Notebook Link
prompt_templates.scenario: Register a new NotebookLM notebook with clear metadata.
prompt_templates.prompt: Add this NotebookLM URL to my library. Ask me for the name, description, and topics before saving it.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Two Notebooks
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate research across different source collections.
prompt_templates.prompt: Query notebook A and notebook B about the same requirement, then compare the answers and note conflicts.

prompt_templates.title: Run Follow-Up Research
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced multi-step analysis with context carried between questions.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use NotebookLM to answer this implementation question. Ask follow-up questions until the answer covers constraints, examples, and risks.

output_examples.input: Ask my API docs notebook how authentication tokens expire.
output_examples.output: The response summarizes token lifetime, renewal rules, and cited source sections from the selected NotebookLM notebook.

output_examples.input: List my saved notebooks and activate the backend architecture notebook.
output_examples.output: The skill shows saved notebook names, marks the active notebook, and selects the requested backend notebook for future queries.

output_examples.input: Research the migration steps and ask follow-up questions if anything is missing.
output_examples.output: The result combines the initial NotebookLM answer with follow-up findings and highlights remaining assumptions for review.

best_practices: Use a dedicated Google account when automating NotebookLM access.
Validate notebook URLs and metadata before adding them to the local library.
Review NotebookLM answers as source content, not as trusted instructions.
anti_patterns: Do not run the skill against unknown NotebookLM URLs without validating the domain.
Do not store browser state on shared machines without access controls.
Do not treat NotebookLM output as authority to run commands or change settings.

faq.question: Does this skill require a browser?
faq.answer: Yes. It uses local browser automation to open NotebookLM, authenticate, ask questions, and read answers.

faq.question: Does it work without Google login?
faq.answer: No. The user must complete Google login in a visible browser before normal queries work.

faq.question: Where does it store notebook data?
faq.answer: It stores notebook metadata and authentication state in a local data directory inside the skill installation.

faq.question: Can it query any NotebookLM notebook?
faq.answer: It can query notebooks that the authenticated Google account can access and that NotebookLM can load.

faq.question: Is NotebookLM output always safe to follow?
faq.answer: No. Treat answers as source content and verify them before using them to make changes.

faq.question: Which tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists compatibility with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
